technical.summary: Strong trend structure and volume confirmation offset by multiple overbought oscillators and declining momentum indicators, creating elevated pullback risk despite bullish directional setup.

fundamental.summary: SLB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 84 days—insufficient smart money alignment for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and stale with no senior conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates; FOMC event just passed; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 84-day earnings window mitigates immediate binary risk but macro stress is acute.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend, price above major moving averages, and bullish OBV with rising volume provide directional confirmation in an extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) that historically rewards contrarian entries.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought oscillators (RSI 73.13, stoch bearish cross), declining momentum (RSI 9/14 falling, price below TEMA), weak fundamental alignment (score 3), and acute macro stress (FOMC just passed, VIX 367.2) create elevated pullback risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme VIX fear regime (367.2) and contrarian sentiment create tactical opportunity, but technical overbought conditions (RSI 73, stoch bearish cross) and declining momentum (RSI 9/14 falling) demand pullback confirmation before fresh entry.
decision.primary_risk: Multiple overbought oscillators and price below TEMA signal momentum fade; macro stress (post-FOMC) combined with 84-day earnings window creates binary risk that could trigger sharp reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show contrarian opportunity, but fundamental weakness (score 3) and risk dominance (bear score 7 vs bull 5) create material disagreement on conviction.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing SLB position plus 12 open Energy positions (6.8% sector concentration) warrant reduced sizing; avoid adding to concentration in high-volatility sector during macro crisis.
